archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-09.6 Evolve and Modernize the Technical Ecosystem
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Technology never stands still — and neither should the organization’s infrastructure. In this step, the organization reviews, upgrades, and modernizes its technology landscape regularly.
Outdated systems are phased out, and new technologies — such as cloud computing, containerization, AI services, and confidential computing — are evaluated and introduced where appropriate. Lessons learned from operations, user feedback, and innovation pilots are used to guide upgrades.
This ongoing evolution ensures that the infrastructure remains aligned with strategic goals, supports innovation, and complies with new security and interoperability standards.
Value created: A continuously improving infrastructure that adapts to technological progress and future organizational needs.
